thesis: The episode argues that replicating Western business models in India often fails because the underlying ecosystem, such as payment and shipping infrastructure, does not exist to support them. Consequently, the next generation of winners in India must build native use cases that address local cultural dynamics and the long-tail merchant segment rather than simply applying US strategies.
